$description: hookai design tokens. Generated from src/app/globals.css -- that file is the source of truth; this is a portable mirror for design tools. Dark-only: there is no light theme. All colours are OKLCH.

meta.tagline: A simulation engine for human relationships.
meta.wordmark: hookai (always lowercase, one word, tight tracking -- the wordmark IS the logo)
meta.stack: Next.js 16 App Router / React 19 / Tailwind CSS v4 / shadcn-ui radix-nova on Radix primitives / lucide icons
meta.targetViewport: 390x844 (mobile-web PWA), plus a projected desktop room view
meta.hexNote: Hex values in the brand spec are LOSSY sRGB renderings of these OKLCH tokens, not source. Measured deltas vs the built CSS: brand #00bbc3 vs actual #00bcc5, muted #a3a3a3 vs #a1a1a1, business #8d56ff vs #8d54ff, friendship #f69e00 vs #f99c00. OKLCH is authoritative -- never round-trip a design tool's hex back into globals.css.

narrative.$description: A life being told. Canonical timeline events, display headlines. Deliberately RARE -- roughly 3 appearances per screen -- so a timeline event reads as special.

sans.$description: The interface. Body copy, form labels, navigation.

heading.$description: Geist, NOT the serif -- this is deliberate. shadcn's CardTitle, DialogTitle, SheetTitle and AlertDialogTitle all consume font-heading. Card titles are furniture; keeping them sans is what preserves the serif's signal.

mono.$description: The engine reporting. Compatibility scores, years, personality dimension values, IDs.

default.$description: Cyan. Means hookai ITSELF -- the engine. Used on pre-lens surfaces (intake, loading, shell) and on the wordmark dot. NEVER follows a lens.
default.knownIssue: Leans slightly green ('pool water'). oklch(0.71 0.13 210) reads cooler and more instrument-like. Under review.

foreground.$description: Text/icon colour on top of brand cyan fills.

base.$description: Pure neutral, deliberately colourless. All colour in the product is meaningful -- cyan means hookai, an accent means a lens. If a surface needs a colour, the design is wrong.

border.$description: Hairline. The resting state of every surface.

contextual.$description: CRITICAL MECHANISM. --primary defaults to the brand cyan and every .lens-* class overrides it. So `primary` always means 'the accent of the current context': cyan before a lens is chosen, the lens hue inside one. All 23 components inherit this for free -- no variant props, no conditional classNames, no per-lens components.

primary.$description: Default (pre-lens) value == brand cyan. Overridden by lens classes.

lens.$description: Put one of these classes on ANY subtree and every token inside retakes its temperature. Custom properties resolve from the nearest declaring ancestor, so this nests correctly. Declared after .dark so they win at equal specificity. Cool brand vs warm lenses is deliberate: the engine never competes with the emotion.

primaryForeground.$description: Dark, because amber is light. The only lens whose foreground is not near-white.

radius.$description: Derived multiplicatively from --radius. Known issue: the scale is very wide -- sm reads nearly square next to 2xl reading nearly circular. Under review.

effect.$description: Glow is for ACTIVE / SELECTED / FOCUSED surfaces ONLY -- never ambient. Everything at rest stays flat with a hairline border, and that contrast is what makes the glow mean something. .glow reads from --primary, so it inherits the surrounding lens automatically.

glow.boxShadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 45%, transparent), 0 0 28px -6px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 50%, transparent)

glowBrand.boxShadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand) 45%, transparent), 0 0 28px -6px color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand) 50%, transparent)

resting.$description: The default. No shadow, no glow. Hairline border only.

components.$description: 23 shadcn/ui components installed and themed. Prefer composing these over introducing new primitives -- 36h build, 3 developers.

notes.form: There is NO `form` component. The current shadcn registry replaced it with `field` (Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldGroup, FieldSet, FieldLegend, FieldSeparator, FieldContent, FieldTitle).
notes.fontHeadingConsumers: CardTitle, DialogTitle, SheetTitle, AlertDialogTitle all use font-heading (Geist, not the serif).
notes.avatarSizing: Avatar has no size prop -- control with Tailwind classes (e.g. className="size-9").
notes.animation: No animation library installed. tw-animate-css is available for CSS enter/exit. `motion` (framer-motion) is NOT installed.

gaps.navigation: The brand spec expects the kit to cover Button, Card, Form (field) and NAVIGATION. There is no navigation component yet -- no app shell, no tab bar, no header. Needed before the multi-screen demo path exists.

rules.$description: Non-negotiable. Violating these is what makes a design system drift.
value: Tokens are the only styling source. No raw hex, no arbitrary spacing, no one-off radius in any component.
If a surface needs a colour that is not a token, propose a NEW TOKEN -- do not inline a value.
Never swap the three type roles: serif narrates a life, sans runs the interface, mono is the engine reporting.
The serif must stay rare (~3 appearances per screen) or it stops meaning anything.
Glow is active state only. Never ambient.
Flat at rest: hairline border, no shadow.
Colour is meaningful: cyan = hookai the engine, accent = the current lens. Neutral everywhere else.
--brand never follows a lens. --primary always does.
Dark only. No light theme, no toggle.

openProblems.$description: Undesigned or unresolved. These are the actual asks -- see CLAUDE_DESIGN_BRIEF.md section 5 for full framing.
openProblems.p1_roomGraph: The projected room view: ~24-40 real people as nodes, compatibility as edges, under one lens. Does not exist. It is the pitch climax and must read from the back of a lit room in ~20s on a dark background.
openProblems.p2_babyReveal: The AI-generated child's face merged from two real photos. The comedic peak. Does not exist.
openProblems.p3_timelineMotion: The timeline is static. Needs choreography -- stagger, what lands when, how the serif enters.
openProblems.p4_intakeFlow: Multi-step mobile form + photo capture + per-lens consent. Completion rate literally IS the demo.
openProblems.p5_lensSelection: The moment of picking romantic/business/friendship. Undesigned. The only place all three accents may legitimately co-appear.
openProblems.p6_latency: Generation takes real seconds. Loading must be a designed moment that sells technical depth, not a spinner.
openProblems.constraint_consent: Real people publicly ranked by romantic compatibility with photos in front of 100 peers. Per-lens opt-in at intake; rankings private to the person who ran them; only MUTUAL matches surfaced publicly. Must be legible in the UI, not fine print.
openProblems.constraint_projector: Dark-only was chosen knowing projected dark loses contrast in a lit room. A 'stage mode' built from the same tokens is welcome.

spacing.$description: 8px baseline grid. Layout rhythm uses EVEN Tailwind steps (gap-2=8px, gap-4=16px, gap-6=24px, p-4, space-y-6). 4px steps are permitted only for optical detail inside a component, e.g. an icon-to-label gap. --spacing is deliberately NOT redefined: Tailwind v4 derives the whole scale from it, so changing it would rescale every existing p-*/gap-*.

brand.$description: Voice, vocabulary and imagery direction. Copy and visual review should hold to this.
brand.tone: Cool engine against warm lenses. Geist and Geist Mono do the reporting -- scores, years, dimension values, IDs. A deliberately rare Instrument Serif narrates the canonical events of a life being told. Copy states events and evidence; it never editorialises.
messagingPillars: The people who would matter to each other are already in the same room -- hookai surfaces them before the night ends.
Coherence is the product: every canonical event stays true to both profiles and to every event before it.
The machinery stays visible -- the engine reporting, not an LLM's opinion.
Consent is legible: per-lens opt-in, rankings private to the person who ran them, only mutual matches surfaced publicly.

imagery.style: Dark stage, life-sim aesthetic -- a timeline of canonical events playing out so you watch a life unfold rather than read a chat log.
subjects: avatars built from real room photos
imagery.treatment: Flat at rest with hairline borders; glow reserved for active, selected, or focused surfaces. Serif kept rare (~3 appearances per screen) for canonical events; mono for scores and years.
